approaches.name: Full OO Handler (Recommended)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for function_call_expression, member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression; REFERENCE_QUERY for qualified_name and name nodes; IMPORT_QUERY for namespace_use_declaration; DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable and assignment patterns. Implement extract_inheritance() to walk base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) children, returning Vec<String> with 'extends X' and 'implements Y' format. Wire into mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language(), add 'php' to lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP and supported_languages(). Add tree-sitter-php to workspace.dependencies and crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml.
pros: Covers all PHP declaration kinds (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums)
Follows established Java/Swift pattern for OO languages
Handles both extends and implements inheritance clauses
Supports HTML-embedded PHP via tree-sitter-php's grammar
Minimal code duplication; reuses LanguageInfo struct
Clear test coverage path via unit tests + integration test
cons: Requires careful tree-sitter query syntax for multiple node kinds
extract_inheritance logic must distinguish base_clause vs class_interface_clause
DEFUSE_QUERY patterns for PHP (variable_declarator, assignment_expression) need validation against grammar
Integration test must verify HTML-embedded PHP edge case

approaches.name: Minimal Handler (Functions + Classes Only)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering only function_definition and class_declaration; omit method_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration. CALL_QUERY for function_call_expression only. IMPORT_QUERY for namespace_use_declaration. DEFUSE_QUERY minimal (local variables only). extract_inheritance() returns empty Vec (not implemented). Wire into registries. Defer method/interface/trait/enum support to future issue.
pros: Smaller initial scope; faster to implement
Covers 80% of typical PHP analysis use cases
cons: Does not meet acceptance criteria (must extract methods, interfaces, traits, enums)
Incomplete OO support; inconsistent with Java/Swift/Kotlin handlers
Issue explicitly lists all declaration kinds in scope

approaches.name: Separate PHP and PHP-Only Handlers
approaches.description: tree-sitter-php grammar includes two variants: php/ (HTML-embedded) and php_only/ (pure PHP). Create two handlers, php.rs and php_only.rs, each with separate queries. Wire both into mod.rs and lang.rs with separate language names 'php' and 'php-only'. Add extensions .php -> php, .phtml -> php-only.
pros: Explicit handling of HTML-embedded vs pure PHP
Potential performance gain if pure PHP queries are simpler
cons: Issue explicitly says '.phtml' is NOT in scope
tree-sitter-php grammar auto-detects PHP-only vs embedded; separate handlers unnecessary

recommendation: Implement Approach 1 (Full OO Handler). It meets all acceptance criteria, follows the established pattern from Java/Swift/Kotlin integrations, and leverages tree-sitter-php's unified grammar that handles both HTML-embedded and pure PHP. The DEFUSE_QUERY can be adapted from Java's pattern (local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, identifier). extract_inheritance() must walk base_clause children for extends and class_interface_clause children for implements, following the grammar structure confirmed in node-types.json. This approach has medium complexity but delivers complete PHP support in one PR.

inheritance_walk_citation: For class_declaration: (1) call node.child_by_field_name('name') to get the class name node; (2) iterate node.child() from 0 to node.child_count(), checking each child.kind() for 'base_clause' (extends) and 'class_interface_clause' (implements); (3) for base_clause, iterate its named_child() from 0 to named_child_count(), extracting text from children of kind 'name', 'qualified_name', or 'relative_name', prepending 'extends '; (4) for class_interface_clause, iterate its named_child() similarly, prepending 'implements '. For interface_declaration: only base_clause children are present (extends, not implements). For trait_declaration: no inheritance support. For enum_declaration: only class_interface_clause children (no extends). Source: tree-sitter-php php/src/node-types.json class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration entries.
